title.value: Improving day-ahead Solar Irradiance Time Series Forecasting by Leveraging Spatio-Temporal Context
title.justification: The title was chosen based on its clear focus on improving solar irradiance forecasting through the use of spatio-temporal context, which is a central aspect of the paper.
title.quote: Title: Improving day-ahead Solar Irradiance Time Series Forecasting by Leveraging Spatio-Temporal Context

extractions.description: The paper presents a deep learning architecture called CrossViViT to improve the accuracy of day-ahead solar irradiance forecasting by utilizing spatio-temporal context from satellite data. It aims to enhance solar energy integration into the grid, thereby contributing to climate change mitigation. The paper proposes a multi-quantile model for predicting Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI) and uses a unique dataset spanning 14 years. It focuses on improving prediction accuracy under varied and challenging weather conditions.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper emphasizes the role of solar power in mitigating climate change by reducing CO2 emissions and addresses the challenges in integrating solar power into the grid due to variability in solar irradiance.
climate_change_is_central.quote: Solar power harbors immense potential in mitigating climate change by substantially reducing CO2 emissions.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on improving solar irradiance forecasting to better integrate solar power into the electrical grid, which directly contributes to climate change mitigation by enhancing renewable energy utilization.
primary_category.quote: Accurate forecasting of solar irradiance can assist grid operators in dealing with the variability of solar power, leading to a more efficient and dependable integration of solar power into the grid.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper discusses methodologies for solar irradiance prediction, which is a significant element of climate science, particularly in terms of understanding and forecasting solar energy availability.
secondary_categories.quote: Accurate forecasting of solar irradiance requires modeling cloud cover, as well as accounting for the inherent variability of the system.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's development of a forecasting model for solar irradiance is aimed at improving the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid, making it a part of renewable energy and grid optimization efforts.
primary_sub_category.quote: This study reveals the inadequacy of conventional testing schemes using conventional metrics like MAE or RMSE on an entire dataset for evaluating solar irradiance forecasting models.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The use of deep learning to predict solar irradiance incorporates modeling and predictions, relevant to climate modeling and predictions.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Our approach aims to integrate the available historical time-series data with video clips of spatio-temporal physical context to enhance the prediction of future time series for solar irradiance.

applications.value: Forecasting renewable energy production and demand
applications.justification: The paper specifically focuses on improving the forecasting of solar irradiance, which is a crucial parameter for predicting renewable energy production from solar power systems.
applications.quote: Accurate forecasting of solar irradiance can assist grid operators in dealing with the variability of solar power.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories sufficiently encapsulate the themes and contributions of the paper.
new_primary_category.quote: The primary focus of the paper is suitable under existing categories such as Climate Change Mitigation and Renewable Energy and Grid Optimization.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's themes fit well into the existing sub-categories, particularly Renewable Energy and Grid Optimization.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The focus on improving solar irradiance forecasting aligns well with Renewable Energy and Grid Optimization.
